rationale: With only 5 minutes to close, any position opened now faces forced market liquidation at the close, creating unacceptable slippage risk on a stock that gapped down ~7% on a significant earnings miss and has been trading with high volatility (ATR ~$0.11 on 5m bars). The last few candles show low volume and tight consolidation near $13.35-13.38 with no clear directional momentum, and the risk/reward of entering a position that must be closed within minutes does not justify the spread and execution risk.
